ortak.cevrimdisi: No internet connection — changes cannot be saved.

tasarim.aciklama: Drag and drop fields to arrange the form. Changes stay in the draft; users are unaffected until you publish.
tasarim.paletAciklama: Drag onto the canvas to add. Drag a field back here to remove it.
tasarim.satirKolonlariAciklama: Reorder with the arrows, set the width in pixels, switch off columns you do not use.
tasarim.birimPxAciklama: The grid grows with its content and scrolls sideways.
tasarim.birimYuzdeAciklama: Width is a share of the screen; above 100% total the grid scrolls horizontally.
tasarim.ekranSecAciklama: Choose the screen whose design you want to change.
tasarim.onayRoluAciklama: Used as the ERP approval role when a request is submitted. Published together with the design.
tasarim.alanSecin: Select a field on the canvas to see its settings.
tasarim.gizliAciklama: The field is not shown to users, but the default value below is still submitted. To drop it entirely, drag it back to the palette.
tasarim.saltOkunurKilitli: This value is generated by the program; it is always read-only.
tasarim.kaldirilamaz: This field is required for saving and cannot be removed.
tasarim.yayinlandi: Design published; users now see this layout.
tasarim.yayinOnayMesaj: This layout will apply to all users. The previous version is archived and can be restored.
tasarim.kolonSec: Select a column to change its settings.
tasarim.erpZorunlu: ERP marks this field as required; it cannot be turned off.

dogrulama.enAzBirSatir: At least one request line is required.
dogrulama.aciklamaUzun: Description may be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.hakkindaUzun: About may be at most 3072 characters.
dogrulama.adresUzun: Delivery address may be at most 200 characters.

anasayfa.aciklama: Access your ERP operations from the left menu.
anasayfa.bosDurum: The Purchase Request module will be here soon.

sql.aciklama: Test and Live connection definitions for the ERP MSSQL server. Stored procedures run against the active environment.
sql.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the server, port or username.
sql.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: ERP writes (stored procedure calls) go to the selected environment's database.
sql.testSecimAciklama: Writes go to the test database — safe to experiment.
sql.canliSecimAciklama: Writes go to the production ERP database.
sql.canliOnayMesaj: From now on ALL writes will go to the production ERP database. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.

mail.aciklama: SMTP server and sender details for mails sent by the application (alerts, notifications).
mail.sifreNotu: Password is saved. Leave blank to keep it. Re-enter it if you change the server, port, username or encryption.
mail.sifreGirilmedi: No password yet; mail cannot be sent while a username is set.
mail.yonlendirmeAciklama: If set, ALL mails sent by the application go only to this address, not to the real recipients. Use during testing.
mail.yonlendirmeAktif: Redirect is on: all mails go only to {{adres}}.
mail.testAciklama: Sends a test mail with the saved settings; unsaved changes are not used. SMTP acceptance does not guarantee delivery to the inbox.
mail.testGonderildi: Test mail handed to the SMTP server: {{alici}}

dogrulama.sunucuGecersiz: Enter only the host name (e.g. smtp.office365.com), without scheme, port or spaces.
dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.

entegrator.aciklama: Test and Live account definitions of the e-Invoice integrator (İzibiz). Invoices are read from the active environment.
entegrator.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password. Re-enter it if you change the username or the API address.
entegrator.sinamaKapsami: This test only verifies the username and password; permission to read invoices is checked separately when listing.
entegrator.ortamUyumsuz: Warning: ERP (SQL) and the integrator are in different environments. Reconciliation and alerts will use data from different environments; results may be misleading.
entegrator.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: invoices are read from the integrator account of the selected environment. Chosen independently of the SQL environment.
entegrator.testSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the integrator's test account.
entegrator.canliSecimAciklama: Invoices are read from the real integrator account.
entegrator.canliOnayMesaj: After this, invoices will be read from the real integrator account. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.
dogrulama.vknGecersiz: Tax ID must be 10 digits (national ID 11) and contain only digits.
dogrulama.apiAdresiGecersiz: Address must be https://host (no path or query).

entegrator.apiAdresiNotu: If left empty, the environment default is used: {{varsayilan}}. Re-enter the password if you change the address.

roller.aciklamaMetni: Roles group permissions; roles are assigned to users on the Users screen. System administrators already have every permission.
roller.silOnayMesaj: Role "{{ad}}" will be deleted; {{sayi}} user(s) will lose its permissions.

dogrulama.adCokUzun: Role name can be at most 64 characters.
dogrulama.aciklamaCokUzun: Description can be at most 255 characters.

kullanicilar.aciklama: ERP users are added automatically on first login. Local users can be created for people outside the ERP. Users are never deleted, only deactivated.
kullanicilar.lokalAciklama: Local users are for people without an ERP account. It cannot be created if an ERP user with the same name exists.
kullanicilar.erpBilgiNotu: This is an ERP user: name, e-mail and password come from the ERP and cannot be changed here.
kullanicilar.pasifYapilamazNotu: Your own account and the backup administrator account cannot be deactivated.
kullanicilar.yoneticiNotu: As a system administrator (ERP flag) this user already has every permission.

dogrulama.kullaniciAdiBicimi: Username must be 3-64 characters; only letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash.
dogrulama.sifreKural: Password must be at least 10 characters and contain letters and digits.

alarm.aciklama: Mail alerts for e-Invoices. Rules are evaluated on the active integrator account; alerts of the test account go only to the redirect address on the Mail (SMTP) screen. Mails carry no invoice details, only counts and a link.

parametre.gun: Days to wait after arrival at İzibiz

senkron_arizasi.aciklama: Technical alert when fetching from İzibiz fails repeatedly or data is not updated for the given time; a "resolved" mail when it recovers.

gunluk_ozet.aciklama: Every day at the given time, counts and totals of incoming and outgoing invoices first seen the previous day.

erp_okumadi.aciklama: Once a day, newly found incoming invoices that the ERP has not read although they reached İzibiz more than the given days ago. No alert when data is stale.

dogrulama.aliciZorunlu: An active rule needs at least one recipient.
dogrulama.aliciGecersiz: One of the recipients is not a valid e-mail address.
dogrulama.aralik: Enter a whole number between {{en}} and {{cok}}.

bildirim.aciklamaMetni: Failed or deliberately skipped notifications are listed too, so the reason for a missing mail is visible here.

kodlar.OLAY_KAPANDI: The problem was resolved before sending.
kodlar.TEST_YONLENDIRME_YOK: Test account alert; not sent to real recipients because no redirect address is set on the Mail (SMTP) screen.
kodlar.YENI_OLAY_YOK: Evaluated; no new invoices to report.
kodlar.SMTP_HATASI: The SMTP server did not accept the mail; will retry.
kodlar.ACILIS_GONDERILMEDI: Not sent because the opening mail of this problem was never sent.

hata.AG_HATASI: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
hata.YETKISIZ: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
hata.ERISIM_ENGELLI: You are not authorized for this action.
hata.DOGRULAMA: There are errors in the submitted data.
hata.COK_FAZLA_ISTEK: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_ERISILEMEDI: Could not reach the integrator. Check the network and try again.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_KIMLIK_HATALI: Integrator username or password is incorrect.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_YANIT_GECERSIZ: The integrator returned an unexpected response.
hata.ENTEGRATOR_AKTIF_YOK: No active integrator environment is selected.
hata.guncellendiOtomatik: A new version has been installed; it takes effect after a refresh.
hata.guncellendiElle: Refresh the page to switch to the new version.
hata.EFATURA_EXCEL_COK_BUYUK: The filter matches more invoices than the Excel limit. Narrow the date range.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_SURUYOR: A manual sync is already queued or running.
hata.EFATURA_SENKRON_KAPALI: e-Invoice sync is disabled on the server.
hata.BEKLENMEYEN_HATA: An unexpected error occurred during sync (see server log).
hata.YAZMA_HATASI: Invoices could not be written to the database.

efatura.pdfYukleniyor: Fetching the invoice from the integrator…
efatura.erpOkunduNotu: Integrator flag used by the ERP integration. This screen only shows it and never changes it.
efatura.veriZamaniYok: No successful sync covering today yet.
efatura.senkronKapali: Scheduled sync is disabled on the server; the list is not updated automatically.
efatura.guncelDegil: Data may be stale: no successful sync covering today in the last hour. Recent invoices may be missing.
efatura.ardisikHata: Last {{sayi}} sync runs failed or were incomplete ({{neden}}, {{zaman}}).

dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The date range can be at most {{gun}} days.

senkron.aciklama: Incoming and outgoing invoices in the selected range are re-read from İzibiz (at most {{gun}} days). The job runs in the background; this screen shows its status.
senkron.sirada: Manual sync is queued or running ({{baslangic}} – {{bitis}}).

dogrulama.gelecek: End date cannot be in the future.
dogrulama.sira: End date cannot be before start date.
dogrulama.cokGenis: The range can be at most {{gun}} days.

efatura.durumAlinamadi: Sync status could not be loaded; it is unknown whether the list is current.
